reference_sql:
WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, spend,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY spend DESC) AS spend_level
  FROM campaign_spend
)
SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, spend, spend_level
FROM ranked
WHERE spend_level <= 2
alternatives:
WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
)
SELECT cs.channel_id, cs.campaign_id, cs.spend,
       1 + (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs2.spend) FROM campaign_spend cs2 WHERE cs2.channel_id = cs.channel_id AND cs2.spend > cs.spend) AS spend_level
FROM campaign_spend cs
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs2.spend) FROM campaign_spend cs2 WHERE cs2.channel_id = cs.channel_id AND cs2.spend > cs.spend) < 2

SELECT t.channel_id, t.campaign_id, t.spend, t.spend_level
FROM (
  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.channel_id, c.campaign_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.channel_id ORDER BY SUM(a.spend) DESC) AS spend_level
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.campaign_id
) AS t
WHERE t.spend_level <= 2
